test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DIARY' is written as 'FLFXF' and 'READY' is written as 'THFJF'. How will 'ERROR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fb671a8709239e9667b68489a690d34de49cd9daffdc676a5b7c0f1dd4d98a2.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'DIARY' is written as 'FLFXF'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6e0a696786b968952e583d1388f78d46c4e8e1f62a71c53f4679d25e50c249f.png] 

'READY' is written as 'THFJF'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdac1e3ef1b285be9ccc8a695bb342d2cf019e0b78e7990803aa35b122d1d3de.png] 

Similarly, for 'ERROR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75857166d6005f9cd8d80705bb78ea503a1d517d185622dd203e40e0882074cc.png] 

So, 'ERROR' will be written as 'GUWUY'

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
